title: Emergency Call-Outs and After-Hours Visit Minimums on TimeBank Service Visits
content:
**Service call-out schedule (TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours).** The class, priority and channel are read from the visit's ticket in the ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket history; a weekday is Monday to Friday and a Saturday or Sunday is read from the resolution's date.

1. *Emergency call-out.* A weekday service visit resolved in the onsite after-hours class on a ticket standing at P1 when resolved and reported by phone is an emergency call-out, and its first 60 minutes are priced at the block's emergency multiplier instead of the after-hours multiplier, the remaining minutes keeping the after-hours multiplier. In figures: the first 60 of the minutes drawn (all of them when fewer than 60 are drawn) are weighted by the emergency multiplier divided by the after-hours multiplier of the block's size, and the remaining minutes are weighted by 1. An emergency call-out is recorded in the emergency band.
2. *After-hours or weekend visit.* Any other service visit resolved in the onsite after-hours class or on a Saturday or Sunday has its minutes raised to at least 120, the raise acting on the minutes as rounded up and taken to the onsite minimum.
3. *Weekday business-hours visit.* A weekday business-hours service visit keeps its minutes as rounded.

| Visit | Minutes drawn, hypothetical 90 rounded minutes |
|---|---|
| weekday, onsite after-hours class, P1 at resolution, reported by phone | 90, of which the first 60 at the emergency weighting |
| weekday, onsite after-hours class, P2 at resolution or reported by portal | 120 |
| Saturday or Sunday, either class | 120 |
| weekday, onsite business-hours class | 90 |

Hypothetical figures for the first row on a size with after-hours multiplier 1.5 and emergency multiplier 2.0: 60 minutes at 2.0 and 30 minutes at 1.5 give 120 plus 45, that is 165 weighted minutes, or 2.75 hours at the technician ratio.
